name: PPC Flexible Packaging
old_description: As a leading manufacturer of custom flexible packaging, we proudly serve clients across the globe. No matter the industry, we work hard to understand your business and create the perfect custom flexible packaging for your organization. With our unmatched team, commitment to sustainability, and ability to create sterilizable packaging materials, we’re the best choice for your business.
about:
PPC Flexible Packaging operates from Buffalo Grove, Illinois, where it runs an advanced flexible packaging manufacturing facility. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

The company produces custom flexible packaging including pouches, bags, rollstock, reclosable packaging, and cleanroom stock products. Its capabilities span prototyping (with 86% of projects turned around in two days or less), in-house design and graphics, digital and flexographic printing (G7 Master certified), regular and extrusion lamination, converting, finishing, quality control, and distribution. The facility leverages cutting-edge finishing technology and ongoing equipment investment, though specific machine models are not public.

PPC Flex serves food (snack, frozen, bakery, better-for-you), healthcare and specialty (sterile packaging, critical environment components, microelectronics), petcare, nutraceuticals, fresh produce, floral, consumer packaging (household products), and cleaning products. Customers range from pet food and snack brands to medical device and microelectronics firms.

The company's stated purpose is to “create powerful packaging experiences,” emphasizing agile systems, a passionate team, and leading-edge innovations to manage complexity from design to shipment. It highlights G7 Master and GMI certifications, sterilizable packaging materials, and a commitment to sustainability as differentiators.
